0022600004.text: Both teams open their 2026-27 seasons, with the Heat hosting the Timberwolves. Minnesota swept the two 2025-26 meetings, most recently winning 122-94 in Minneapolis on January 6, 2026. Miami's Vladislav Goldin is day-to-day with an ankle injury and is a game-time decision, while Minnesota is without Donte DiVincenzo, who is out after Achilles surgery, and Rocco Zikarsky, who is day-to-day with an undisclosed reason and is also a game-time decision.
